title: USS Kearny torpedoed
body:
The destroyer USS Kearny was torpedoed by the German submarine U-568 while helping guard a convoy off Iceland. Eleven sailors were killed.

The crew kept her afloat and reached Reykjavik two days later. America was not yet at war.
photoNote: Kearny at Reykjavik on 19 Oct 1941, two days after the hit. The torpedo hole is visible midships. U.S. Navy photo 80-G-28788, public domain.
